svg.title: MD 04 Fused Update
svg.desc: Plot of a Kalman filter update in X–Y position. A large tilted purple prediction ellipse, centered near (8, 5), overlaps a smaller orange measurement ellipse near (12, 8). A green arrow labeled K times the innovation moves the estimate from the prediction center to a small filled green fused estimate near (11, 7.6), mostly inside the measurement ellipse. Annotations: Kalman gain K[0,0] equals 0.72; K equals P sub pred H transpose S inverse; P sub k equals (I minus K H) P sub pred.
